summary.text: Mahendra Bakshi is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 38, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He led the September 8 Democratic primary with 1,985 votes (91.3 percent) and previously ran for the House in Hillsborough 14 in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Bakshi advanced from the Democratic primary for Hillsborough 14 in 2022 and again in 2024, and in both years finished behind the two Republican winners in the general election.
